title: Spend the remaining day on what lasts
summary: Life is shrinking, so spend it on what can endure beyond it. Use this day for what can still remain.
takeaway: Use this day for what can still remain.
lifeApplication: Before drifting into another task, choose one act that treats life as opportunity for meeting, service, or honest return.

source.shortMeaning: Life is shrinking, so spend it on what can endure beyond it.
source.lifeApplication: When time slips, turn one remaining hour toward the profit of Naam.

evidence.coreClaim: Life is shrinking, so spend it on what can endure beyond it.
